svg.title: Open studio: orient a portrait toward the invitation
svg.desc: Only the photograph is reflected horizontally within its unchanged portrait frame. Identical source bytes, crop extent, text, typography, positions, colors, paper and lighting are reused. The fictional artist faces the invitation in the revision; no observed gaze path or response improvement is claimed.
